description: Search for disaster events with various filters. Returns a list of events matching the criteria, ordered by date descending.

alertLevel.description: Alert level filter: 'green', 'orange', 'red', or combination like 'orange;red'

country.description: Filter by country name or ISO code

eventTypes.description: Comma-separated event types to include (e.g., 'EQ,TC,FL'). Leave empty for all types.

eventname.description: Filter by eventame, tipically for the TC, cyclone name

fromDate.description: Start date for search range (ISO 8601 format)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 20)

toDate.description: End date for search range (ISO 8601 format)

name: search_events
